title: Do speech therapists at Pinnacle Blooms help children with Autism improve their non-verbal communication as well?
metaTitle: Improving Non-Verbal Communication in Children with Autism - Pinnacle Blooms
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network’s speech therapists aid in developing both verbal and non-verbal communication skills, facilitating holistic communicative development in children with Autism.
html: Absolutely, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, our qualified speech therapists not only work on verbal communication, but they also put much emphasis on non-verbal communication. This includes facilitating children with Autism to understand and utilize gestures, facial expressions, as well as body language effectively. Our holistic approach aids in enhancing the overall communicative skills of your child, both verbally and non-verbally.
